parole.significato: A low-lying meadow by the side of a river.
parole.testo: From Northern English dialectal and Scots haugh, from Northern Middle English *halgh, from Old English healh (“corner, nook”), from Proto-West Germanic *halh. Doublet of hale.

parole.significato: A quick hostile or predatory incursion or invasion in a battle.
parole.testo: From Scots raid, from Northern Middle English rade, from Old English rād (“a riding, an expedition on horseback, road”), whence also the inherited English road (“way, street”).
